changelog:
What's new in 1.33:
• Search by actor or director — open their filmography
• New "Connection" settings: switch catalog or images to an alternative source if the default won't load (bypass possible blocks)
• Loading skeletons instead of spinners — smoother first load
• Fixes: "My List" no longer flickers; watched ✓ and "Series" badges now show on similar / collection / filmography grids
